title: One Piece x Japan National Football Team Special Collab Video Revealed Ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026
content: ONE PIECE and Japan’s national football team, SAMURAI BLUE, have revealed a special collaboration video ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The video, titled “To Our Highest Peak” (Oretachi no Saiko Chiten e), premiered on June 1 on the official ONE PIECE YouTube channel and JFA TV.
author: Anime Corner

title: My Hero Academia Studio’s Hottest 2026 Anime Is About to Deliver Its Most Thrilling Battle
content: There is no doubt that one of the reasons My Hero Academia became such a successful anime is its adaptation by Bones Film. The studio has built a reputation for producing some of the greatest anime of all time, with fan favorites such as Mob Psycho 100 and Fullmetal Alchemist also coming from the studio.
author: ComicBook

title: Intruders Land on Elbaph in ONE PIECE Episode 1165 Preview
content: ONE PIECE revealed the preview for Episode 1165, with intruders targeting Loki making an appearance. The anime recently revealed a trailer for the Holy Knights of God , introducing their voice cast led by Kenjiro Tsuda as Shamrock.
author: Anime Corner

title: 40 Years Later, Studio Ghibli’s First Feature Film Returns With a New Release
content: Studio Ghibli has etched its name in history as one of the most iconic animation studios Japan has ever seen. Established in 1985, Ghibli is still known for beautifully crafted animated films, rich storytelling, deep emotional impact, and more.
author: ComicBook

title: MediaOCD to Release Restored HD Vampire Princess Miyu Anime on BD on its Website Only on September 8
content: AnimEigo and MediaOCD announced on Thursday they will release the restored HD Blu-ray Disc of the 1988-1989 four-episode OVA adaptation of Narumi Kakinouchi 's Vampire Princess Miyu manga "on or before" September 8, only on MediaOCD 's website.
author: ANN

title: 5 Magic-Fueled 2026 Anime Series You Need to See If You Love KPop Demon Hunters
content: Even nearly a year since its release, KPop Demon Hunters continues to remain popular, with fans eagerly awaiting the sequel to the Netflix sensation. While there have been promising updates regarding how the franchise will continue, it is clear that the new releases are far from arriving anytime soon.

title: Paradox Live The Animation Gets Film Project by Studio GRAPH77
content: The " Paradox Live Dope Show 2026" event announced this weekend that the Paradox Live The Animation series will have an upcoming film project. According to the teaser above, Studio GRAPH77 ( Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 's "Shikaku") is producing the film project.
